svg.title: KeyHelix
svg.desc: Local-first workspace · Linux v1 release. Offline-first secrets and authorization workspace with scoped access, audited reveals and key rotation. The published release targets Linux x86_64. Requires local Keycloak, OpenBao and rootless Podman services; it is not a hosted SaaS.

g.data-label: Protect secret material with scoped access and auditable rotation.
Offline-first secrets and authorization workspace with scoped access, audited reveals and key
rotation. The published release targets Linux x86_64.
Requires local Keycloak, OpenBao and rootless Podman services; it is not a hosted SaaS.
